payload.text: ST0092 WP-04 bank (ii), after cc's WP-05 lands: the recipient changes. wb ask to a retired node is refused naming the retirement, wb announce skips it, a message to the leaver it never handled is named at its sender's next pickup, and wb archive message accepts it; the help for wb ask, wb announce and wb archive message names the retired-node behaviour (vc's ruling). Builds on bank (i)'s WbNode.retired.
